Product Overview:
These men's casual pants feature a straight-leg wide-cut design with Y2K dark gothic letter prints, showcasing a unique punk fashion aesthetic. Made from polyester blend elastic fabric with a fleece lining, they offer warmth and comfort, making them ideal for autumn wear and travel.

Material: Polyester (Polyester Blend)
Style: Punk/Streetwear
Features: Slight elasticity, fleece-lined, drawstring closure, includes belt, heat-transfer letter pattern
Color: Gray, Black, White, Red, Yellow, Blue, Navy, Purple, Coffee

Available Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL
